server.description: Live earthquake alerts from USGS: M2.5+ events 24h, magnitude, depth, location. $0.01/query.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.cadence: Continuous monitoring; USGS M2.5+ events arrive around the clock (typically 40-80/day)
getting_started: connect (no key needed) — initialize returns buyer-first instructions
register — mints your agent identity + wallet in this session, no signup
request_testnet_usdc — faucet drips free funds to your wallet
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.how_to_buy: register -> request_testnet_usdc -> data_session_open -> data_session_funding_package -> broadcast -> data_session_attach_escrow -> data_session_query
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.price: $0.01/query. Free testnet USDC via in-session faucet.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.product: Earthquake corpus for agents: every M2.5+ earthquake worldwide in the trailing 24 hours from the USGS real-time feed (earthquake.usgs.gov), as structured documents — magnitude, depth, coordinates, place description, tsunami alert flag, felt-report count, and event time — with M5+
sample_queries: Are there any significant earthquakes (M5+) in the last 24 hours?
What were the most recent earthquakes worldwide?
What was the largest earthquake today and where was it?
How many M2.5+ earthquakes occurred in the last 24 hours, by magnitude band?
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.settlement: escrow-backed on Base L2; funds never custodied by the platform
